blocks.html: Sequential Consistency
blocks.text: Sequential Consistency

blocks.html: All operations appear in some global order that is the same for all clients, but this order does not have to respect real-time order.
blocks.text: All operations appear in some global order that is the same for all clients, but this order does not have to respect real-time order.

blocks.html: Guarantee:
blocks.text: Guarantee:

blocks.html: Every client sees all operations in the same sequence, ensuring agreement on order.
blocks.text: Every client sees all operations in the same sequence, ensuring agreement on order.

blocks.html: Unlike linearizability, operations may appear out of real-time order as long as the global sequence is consistent across clients.
blocks.text: Unlike linearizability, operations may appear out of real-time order as long as the global sequence is consistent across clients.

blocks.html: Trade-offs:
blocks.text: Trade-offs:

blocks.html: Pros:
blocks.text: Pros:

blocks.html: Provides predictable ordering for all clients.
blocks.text: Provides predictable ordering for all clients.

blocks.html: Easier to implement than strong consistency (linearizability).
blocks.text: Easier to implement than strong consistency (linearizability).

blocks.html: Cons/Anomalies:
blocks.text: Cons/Anomalies:

blocks.html: Complex than other weak consistency models.
blocks.text: Complex than other weak consistency models.

blocks.html: Slower than weaker models like eventual consistency due to coordination requirements.
blocks.text: Slower than weaker models like eventual consistency due to coordination requirements.

blocks.html: Real-Time Order Violation: A later operation might appear before an earlier one if timing is ignored.
blocks.text: Real-Time Order Violation: A later operation might appear before an earlier one if timing is ignored.

blocks.html: Collaborative Editing:
blocks.text: Collaborative Editing:

blocks.html: All users see the same sequence of edits, ensuring a consistent document state.

blocks.text: Shared Counters:
